description: Mounted on a pylon at the Rocky Mountain House Flying Club at the airport, on loan from the Bomber Command Museum of Canada at Nanton. Usually quoted by its earlier RCAF serial 21437. Note that Nanton's own 21082 is painted as 21437, so photographs captioned '21437' can refer to either airframe.
museum_name: Rocky Mountain House Flying Club CT-133 Silver Star, Rocky Mountain House
